description: Outline Application (appearance, landscaping, scale and layout only) for the erection of two detached single storey dwellings at 147 Eastcote Lane
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<div id="x_mail-editor-reference-message-container"><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><span data-olk-copy-source="MailCompose">The development of any buildings (other than works of demolition) hereby permitted shall not be commenced until works for the disposal of surface and foul water, including the incorporation of sustainable drainage features as appropriate, have been provided on site in accordance with details to be submitted to, and approved &nbsp;in writing by, the local planning authority. These works shall thereafter be retained.</span></p></div>

<div id="x_mail-editor-reference-message-container"><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">Approval of the details shown below (the "reserved matters") shall be obtained from the local planning authority in writing before any development is commenced:</p><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><br></p><ol start="1" style="margin-top: 0cm; margin-bottom: 0cm;"><li style="font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; margin: 0cm;">Access</li></ol></div>

<div id="x_mail-editor-reference-message-container"><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><i data-olk-copy-source="MailCompose">No development shall take place until a Construction Method Statement has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority in accordance with the format and guidance provided by Transport for London – www.tfl.gov.uk. The Construction Method Statement shall provide for:</i></p><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><i>a) Parking of vehicles of site operatives/visitors.</i></p><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><i>b) HGV access to site – loading and unloading of plant and materials.</i></p><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><i>c) Number of HGV’s anticipated.</i></p><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><i>d) Storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development.</i></p><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><i>e) Programme of work and phasing.</i></p><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><i>f) Site layout plan.</i></p><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><i>g) Highway condition (before, during, after).</i></p><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><i>h) Measures to control dust and dirt during construction.</i></p><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><i>i) A scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works; and</i></p><div id="x_mail-editor-reference-message-container"><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><i data-olk-copy-source="MailCompose">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Method Statement, or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority.</i></p></div></div>

<div id="x_mail-editor-reference-message-container"><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><span data-olk-copy-source="MailCompose">No site works or development shall commence until details of the levels of the building(s), hardstanding and terrace areas in relation to the adjoining land and highway(s), and any other changes proposed in the levels of the site, have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.&nbsp;</span></p></div>

<div id="x_mail-editor-reference-message-container"><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><i data-olk-copy-source="MailCompose">Notwithstanding the approved scheme’s specific details, prior to occupation of the development hereby permitted, the applicant shall obtain a Secured by Design Certification to demonstrate how they intend to minimise the risk of crime in a visually acceptable manner, or supply sufficient justification where the accreditation requirements cannot be met, which are to be submitted and approved in writing by the local planning authority. These Secured by Design measures shall be implemented prior to occupation, and the development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details thereafter wherever practical.</i></p></div>

<div id="x_mail-editor-reference-message-container"><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><i data-olk-copy-source="MailCompose">Notwithstanding the approved plans, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until further details of planned refuse and recycling strategy for the site are provided to ensure the internal storage area is viable, including details regarding drag distance to highway; anticipated positioning of bins on collection day and storage capacity, to be submitted and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall then be carried out in accordance with the details as so agreed; the storage provision shall be in place prior to the first occupation of the development; and retained thereafter. The refuse and recycling bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within this approved designated refuse storage area.</i></p></div>

<div id="x_mail-editor-reference-message-container"><p style="margin: 0cm; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;"><span data-olk-copy-source="MailCompose">Notwithstanding the approved plans, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until further or revised details of the cycle storage area have been provided have been submitted and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall then be carried out in accordance with the details as so agreed; the storage provision shall be in place prior to the first occupation of the development; and retained thereafter.</span></p></div>
